notes.title: First Update
notes.notes: [h2]New Ports[/h2][p]Five new ports added to the game.[/p][list][*][p]Balboa[/p][/*][*][p]Colón[/p][/*][*][p]Lima[/p][/*][*][p]Los Angeles[/p][/*][*][p]Vancouver[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]New Features[/h2][p][/p][h3]Full screen[/h3][p]There is now a new button in settings to toggle full screen (not available on Steam deck as this is always full screen).[/p][p][/p][h3]Telegraph[/h3][p]The telegraph colours have been slightly adjusted to make it more visible what the actual speed is compared to what is requested. There is also a new option in settings to toggle a split style telegraph instead.[/p][p][/p][h2]Bugfixes[/h2][list][*][p]A typo in the weather dialog has been fixed.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Code[/h2][p]The game is upgraded to use Unity 6.2, this should not affect gameplay.[/p]
